answer_1.quote: In this paper, we aim to foster reliable development of summarization systems from the dataset perspective. Concretely, we present ACLSUM, a new multi-aspect extreme summarization dataset manually annotated and validated by domain experts.
answer_1.outputs: multi-aspect summaries of scientific papers (Challenge, Approach, Outcome)

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report standard ROUGE scores and BERTScore with as the underlying model.

answer_4.quote: Additionally to the automatic evaluation, we also perform a manual evaluation to qualitatively assess the quality of generated summaries.
